local m_ajahs = require('Module:Ajahs')
local m_ds = require('Module:Dataset')
local m_utils = require('Module:Utils')
local m_places = require('Module:Places')
local m_chars_json = mw.loadJsonData('Module:Characters/characters.json')
local m = {}

function m._refs_wt(frame, args, refs)
	if args.suppress_refs == true then return "" end
	if refs == nil then return (args.suppress_verify == false and "{{verify}}" or "") end
	local wt = nil
	for ref_index, ref in ipairs(refs) do
		if ref.ref then
			wt = wt.."{{ref|"..ref.ref.."}}"
		elseif ref.book then
			wt = "{{ref/book|"..ref.book
			if ref.chapter then
				wt = wt.."|"..ref.chapter
			else
				wt = wt..(ref.entry and "|"..ref.entry or "")
			end
			-- TODO Add support for custom entry display text
			wt = wt.."}}"
		end
	end
	if wt == nil then return (args.suppress_verify == false and "{{verify}}" or "") end
	return wt
end

function m._copy_char_args(args)
	local nargs = {
		ajah = nil,
		all = nil,
		black_ajah = nil,
		channelers = nil,
		darkfriend = nil,
		name = nil,
		page = nil,
		sparkers = nil,
		wilders = nil,
		columns = nil
	}
	if args.ajah then
		nargs.ajah = string.lower(args.ajah)
	end
	if args.all then
		nargs.all = string.lower(args.all) == "true"
	end
	if args.black_ajah then
		nargs.black_ajah = string.lower(args.black_ajah) == "true"
	end
	if args.channelers then
		nargs.channelers = string.lower(args.channelers) == "true"
	end
	if args.darkfriend then
		nargs.darkfriend = string.lower(args.darkfriend) == "true"
	end
	if args.name then
		nargs.name = args.name
	end
	if args.page then
		nargs.page = args.page
	end
	if args.sparkers then
		nargs.sparkers = string.lower(args.sparkers) == "true"
	end
	if args.wilders then
		nargs.wilders = string.lower(args.wilders) == "true"
	end
	if not nargs.black_ajah and nargs.ajah == "black" then
		nargs.black_ajah = true
	end
	if args.columns then
		nargs.columns = {}
		for _, col in ipairs(m_utils._split(string.lower(args.columns), ";")) do
			mw.log("Adding column: "..col)
			nargs.columns[col] = true
		end
	end
	mw.log("Columns: "..(nargs.columns and m_utils._serialize(nargs.columns, "nargs.columns") or "nil"))
	return nargs
end

function m._fill_character(frame, args, character)
	local char = m_utils._json_to_table(character)
	if (char.aes_sedai == nil or (char.aes_sedai ~= nil and char.aes_sedai.aes_sedai == nil)) and char.ajah ~= nil and char.ajah.ajah ~= nil then
		char.aes_sedai = { aes_sedai = true, refs = char.ajah.refs }
	end
	-- mw.log("Checking ajahs: "..(char and m_utils._serialize(char, "char") or "").." - "..(char.ajahs and m_utils._serialize(char.ajahs, "ajahs") or "").." - "..(character.ajah and m_utils._serialize(character.ajah, "ajah") or "").." - "..(character.ajah and character.ajah.ajah or ""))
	if char.ajahs == nil and character.ajah ~= nil and character.ajah.ajah ~= nil then
		char.ajahs = { character.ajah }
	end
	-- mw.log("Checked ajahs: "..(char and m_utils._serialize(char, "char") or "").." -"..(char.ajahs and m_utils._serialize(char.ajahs, "ajahs") or "").." - "..(character.ajah and m_utils._serialize(character.ajah, "ajah") or "").." - "..(character.ajah and character.ajah.ajah or ""))
	if char.darkfriend ~= nil and char.darkfriend.darkfriend == true and char.aes_sedai ~= nil and char.aes_sedai.aes_sedai then
		if char.ajahs == nil then
			char.ajahs = {}
		end
		table.insert(char.ajahs, { ajah = "Black", refs = char.darkfriend.refs })
		if char.aes_sedai and char.aes_sedai.refs then
			char.ajahs[#char.ajahs].refs = char.ajahs[#char.ajahs].refs or {}
			for _, ref in ipairs(char.aes_sedai.refs) do
				table.insert(char.ajahs[#char.ajahs].refs, ref)
			end
		end
		if char.black_ajah == nil then
			char.black_ajah = { black_ajah = true, refs = char.ajahs[#char.ajahs].refs }
		end
	end
	if char.darkfriend == nil and char.black_ajah ~= nil and char.black_ajah.black_ajah == true then
		char.darkfriend = { darkfriend = true, refs = char.black_ajah.refs }
	end
	if char.channeler == nil then
		local refs = {}
		if char.spark ~= nil and char.spark.spark ~= nil and char.spark.refs ~= nil then
			for _, ref in ipairs(char.spark.refs) do
				table.insert(refs, ref)
			end
		end
		if char.wilder ~= nil and char.wilder.wilder ~= nil and char.wilder.refs ~= nil then
			for _, ref in ipairs(char.wilder.refs) do
				table.insert(refs, ref)
			end
		end
		if char.aes_sedai ~= nil and char.aes_sedai.aes_sedai ~= nil and char.aes_sedai.refs ~= nil then
			for _, ref in ipairs(char.aes_sedai.refs) do
				table.insert(refs, ref)
			end
		end
		if #refs == 0 then refs = nil end
		char.channeler = { channeler = (char.spark ~= nil and char.spark.spark) or (char.wilder ~= nil and char.wilder.wilder) or (char.aes_sedai ~= nil and char.aes_sedai.aes_sedai), refs = refs }
	end
	return char
end

function m._get_characters(frame, args, char_args)
	local keys = nil
	local chars = nil
	local chars_ready = false
	if char_args.all then
		chars = m.chars_json
	elseif char_args.name ~= nil then
		if m.chars_json[char_args.name] then
			local character = m.chars_json[char_args.name]
			if (character.name and string.lower(char_args.name) == string.lower(m_ds._get_entity_name(frame, args, character, char_args.name))) then
				chars = { [char_args.name] = character }
			end
		end
	elseif char_args.page ~= nil then
		if m.chars_json[char_args.page] then
			local character = m.chars_json[char_args.page]
			if (character.page and char_args.page == m_ds._get_entity_page(frame, args, character, char_args.page)) then
				chars = { [char_args.page] = character }
			end
		end
	else
		keys = {}
		chars = {}
		for key, character in pairs(m.chars_json) do
			-- TODO properly handle when argument is not provided, but is false
			if ((char_args.channelers == nil or (char_args.channelers == (character.channeler and character.channeler.channeler))) and
				(char_args.ajah == nil or ( -- TODO loop through character.ajahs
					(char_args.ajah == string.lower(character.ajah and character.ajah.ajah or "")) or
					(char_args.ajah == "black" and character.black_ajah and character.black_ajah.black_ajah))) and
				(char_args.darkfriend == nil or (char_args.darkfriend  == (character.darkfriend and character.darkfriend.darkfriend))) and
				(char_args.sparkers == nil or (char_args.sparkers == (character.spark and character.spark.spark))) and
				(char_args.wilders == nil or (char_args.wilders == (character.wilder and character.wilder.wilder)))
			) then
				chars[key] = character
				table.insert(keys, key) -- Avoids an unnecessary iteration over the results
			end
		end
		chars_ready = true
	end
	if chars and keys == nil then
		keys = {}
		for key, character in pairs(chars) do
			table.insert(keys, key)
		end
	end
	table.sort(keys)
	return keys, chars
end

function m._render_character_ul(frame, args, char_args, character, key)
	local rendered = "* "
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.name then
		rendered = rendered.."[["..m_ds._get_entity_page(frame, args, character, key).."]]"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.darkfriend then
		if character.darkfriend and character.darkfriend.darkfriend then
			rendered = rendered.." ([[Darkfriend]]"..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.darkfriend and character.darkfriend.refs)..")"
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.ajah then
		if character.ajahs then
			for _, ajah in ipairs(character.ajahs or {}) do
				rendered = rendered.." ([["..ajah.ajah.." Ajah]]"..m._refs_wt(frame, args, ajah.refs)..")"
			end
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.spark then
		if character.spark or (character.channeler and character.channeler.channeler) then
			rendered = rendered.." ("..((character.spark and character.spark.spark) and "sparker" or "non-sparker")..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.spark and character.spark.refs)..")"
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.wilder then
		if character.wilder or (character.channeler and character.channeler.channeler) then
			rendered = rendered.." ("..((character.wilder and character.wilder.wilder) and "wilder" or "non-wilder")..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.wilder and character.wilder.refs)..")"
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.channel then
		if character.channeler and character.channeler.channeler then
			rendered = rendered.." ([[Channeler]]"..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.channeler and character.channeler.refs)..")"
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.homeland then
		if character.origin and character.origin.origin then
			rendered = rendered.." (from "..(m_places._get_place_link_wt(frame, args, character.origin.origin, false) or "{{Err|msg=Invalid place: "..character.origin.origin.."}}")..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.origin.refs)..")"
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.traits then
		if character.novice and character.novice.novice == true then
			rendered = rendered.." ([[novice]]"..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.novice.refs)..")"
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.notes then
		if character.notes then
			rendered = rendered.." - "
			if type(character.notes) == "table" then
				rendered = rendered..table.concat(character.notes, " ")
			else
				rendered = rendered..character.notes
			end
		end
	end
	if character.notes then rendered = rendered.." ("..character.notes..")" end
	return rendered.."\n"
end

function m._render_character_wikitable_row(frame, args, char_args, character, key, ajah_emoji)
	local rendered = "|-\n"
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.name then
		rendered = rendered.."| [["..m_ds._get_entity_page(frame, args, character, key).."]]"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.darkfriend then
		rendered = rendered.."\n| "
		local val = (character.darkfriend and ((character.darkfriend.darkfriend or (character.black_ajah and character.black_ajah.black_ajah)) and "✅" or "❌")) or ""
		rendered = rendered..val
		if val ~= "" or (character.darkfriend and character.darkfriend.refs) then
			local refs = nil
			if character.darkfriend.refs or character.ajah.refs then
				refs = {}
				for _, ref in ipairs(character.darkfriend.refs) do
					table.insert(refs, ref)
				end
				for _, ref in ipairs(character.ajah.refs) do
					table.insert(refs, ref)
				end
			end
			rendered = rendered..m._refs_wt(frame, args, refs)
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.channel then
		rendered = rendered.."\n| "
		if (character.channeler and character.channeler.channeler) or (character.spark and character.spark.spark) or (character.wilder and character.wilder.wilder) then
			rendered = rendered.."✅"..m._refs_wt(frame, args, (character.channeler and character.channeler.refs) or (character.spark and character.spark.refs) or (character.wilder and character.wilder.refs))
		elseif (character.channeler and character.channeler.channeler == false) then
			rendered = rendered.."❌"..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.channeler and character.channeler.refs)
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.spark then
		rendered = rendered.."\n| "
		if (character.spark ~= nil or (character.channeler ~= nil and character.channeler.channeler)) then
			local val = (character.spark and (character.spark.spark and "✅" or "❌") or "")
			rendered = rendered..val
			if val ~= "" or (character.spark and character.spark.refs) then
				rendered = rendered..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.spark and character.spark.refs)
			end
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.wilder then
		rendered = rendered.."\n| "
		if (character.wilder ~= nil or (character.channeler ~= nil and character.channeler.channeler)) then
			local val = (character.wilder and (character.wilder.wilder and "✅" or "❌") or "")
			rendered = rendered..val
			if val ~= "" or (character.wilder and character.wilder.refs) then
				rendered = rendered..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.wilder and character.wilder.refs)
			end
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.ajah then
		rendered = rendered.."\n| "
		if character.ajahs ~= nil then
			local first_ajah = true
			for _, ajah in ipairs(character.ajahs or {}) do
				if not first_ajah then
					rendered = rendered.."<br />"
				end
				rendered = rendered.."[["..ajah.ajah.." Ajah|"..(ajah_emoji[string.lower(ajah.ajah)] or ajah.ajah).."]]"..m._refs_wt(frame, args, ajah.refs)
				first_ajah = false
			end
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.homeland then
		rendered = rendered.."\n| "
		if character.origin and character.origin.origin then
			rendered = rendered..(m_places._get_place_link_wt(frame, args, character.origin.origin, true) or "{{Err|msg=Invalid place: "..character.origin.origin.."}}")..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.origin.refs)
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.traits then
		rendered = rendered.."\n| "
		if character.novice and character.novice.novice == true then
			rendered = rendered.."[[novice]]"..m._refs_wt(frame, args, character.novice.refs)
		end
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.notes then
		rendered = rendered.."\n| "
		if character.notes then
			if type(character.notes) == "table" then
				if #character.notes > 0 then
					rendered = rendered.."*"..table.concat(character.notes, "\n*")
				end
			else
				rendered = rendered..character.notes
			end
		end
	end
	return rendered.."\n"
end

-- Useful test code:
-- print(p._get_characters_ul(mw.getCurrentFrame(), { sparkers="True", wilders="True" }))
function m._get_characters_ul(frame, args)
	local rendered = ""
	local char_args = m._copy_char_args(args)
	local keys, chars = m._get_characters(frame, args, char_args)
	for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
		rendered = rendered..m._render_character_ul(frame, args, char_args, chars[key], key)
	end
	return frame.preprocess(frame, rendered)
end

function m.get_characters_ul(frame)
	return m_utils.invoke_api(frame, m._get_characters_ul, "_get_characters_ul")
end


-- Useful test code:
-- print(p._get_characters_wikitable(mw.getCurrentFrame(), { all="True", columns="ajah;spark;wilder;homeland" }))
function m._get_characters_wikitable(frame, args)
	local char_args = m._copy_char_args(args)
	local rendered = ""
	local ajah_emoji = m_ajahs._get_ajah_name_emoji_map(frame, args)
	local keys, chars = m._get_characters(frame, args, char_args)
	-- for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
	-- 	rendered = rendered..m_utils._serialize(chars[key], "character").."\n\n"
	-- end
	rendered = rendered.."{| class=\"wikitable sortable\"\n"
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.name then
		rendered = rendered.."! Name\n"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.darkfriend then
		rendered = rendered.."! <span style=\"display:block; writing-mode:vertical-lr; transform:rotate(180deg)\">[[Darkfriend]]</span>\n"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.channel then
		rendered = rendered.."! <span style=\"display:block; writing-mode:vertical-lr; transform:rotate(180deg)\">[[:Category:Channelers|Channel]]</span>\n"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.spark then
		rendered = rendered.."! <span style=\"display:block; writing-mode:vertical-lr; transform:rotate(180deg)\">[[Spark]]</span>\n"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.wilder then
		rendered = rendered.."! <span style=\"display:block; writing-mode:vertical-lr; transform:rotate(180deg)\">[[Wilder]]</span>\n"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.ajah then
		rendered = rendered.."! <span style=\"display:block; writing-mode:vertical-lr; transform:rotate(180deg)\">[[Ajah]]</span>\n"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.homeland then
		rendered = rendered.."! Homeland\n"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.traits then
		rendered = rendered.."! Traits\n"
	end
	if char_args.columns == nil or char_args.columns.notes then
		rendered = rendered.."! Notes\n"
	end
	rendered = rendered.."|-\n"
	for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
		rendered = rendered..m._render_character_wikitable_row(frame, args, char_args, chars[key], key, ajah_emoji)
	end
	rendered = rendered.."|}"
	return frame.preprocess(frame, rendered)
end

function m.get_characters_wikitable(frame)
	return m_utils.invoke_api(frame, m._get_characters_wikitable, "_get_characters_wikitable")
end

-- Useful test code:
-- print(p._get_character_ibox(mw.getCurrentFrame(), { sparkers="True", wilders="True" }))
function m._get_character_ibox(frame, args)
	local rendered = ""
	local chars = m._get_characters(frame, args, m._copy_char_args(args))
	for key, character in pairs(chars) do
		rendered = rendered.."* [["..m_ds._get_entity_page(frame, args, character, key).."]]"
		rendered = rendered.."\n"
	end
	return frame.preprocess(frame, rendered)
end

function m.get_character_ibox(frame)
	return m_utils.invoke_api(frame, m._get_character_ibox, "_get_character_ibox")
end

m.chars_json = {}
for key, character in pairs(m_chars_json) do
	m.chars_json[key] = m._fill_character(nil, nil, character)
end

return m
